name: Huellas En La Nieve (cube)
author: notlsa
description: NOTE: YOU MUST BEAT THE LEVEL PAUSELESS. Jump over the blue pad at 23%. Jump from the corner of the first block at 24% and fall until the blocks disappear. Jump at 61.4%, 71.5%, 76.1%, 79.1%, 80.9%, 83.4%, 89.1%, 90.8%, 91.7%, 93.9%, 96.8%, 97.8%, 98.9%, and 99.9% to not die to the slopes.
